blocks.text: UNITED NATIONS, United States — US President Donald Trump signed a security deal Tuesday with the leaders of Greenland and Denmark, cooling temperatures after his contentious calls to acquire the autonomous Danish territory. “It’s going to be a long-term, fantastic relationship,” Trump said at a signing ceremony on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York. “This is tremendous for Europe and for the United States and for everybody,” he added.
